CrossMux 1.5.5 introduces the touch-friendly Inx interface, adds Calculator and Electronic Woodfish, and makes WeRead and web file management faster and more reliable.

## Interface and apps

- Add the Inx theme with main-tab navigation, touch support, and selectable layouts for recent books, the library, and apps. Fresh installs use Inx by default; existing saved theme choices are preserved.
- Add Calculator and Electronic Woodfish, including a recoverable on-SD counter for Woodfish.
- Add an About page showing the firmware version, device model, heap, and SD-card usage.
- Surface file transfer and configured OPDS libraries in Apps, and refine Inx action buttons.

## WeRead and performance

- Make shelf navigation consistent, prefetch only the first ten covers, cache later pages on demand, and offer full cover caching when refreshing the shelf.
- Speed up WeRead downloads by removing the shard delay and batching XHTML and image-index writes.
- Restore two-em paragraph indentation and correctly detect metadata for large TXT content.
- Speed up post-OTA SD-font prewarming and trim the Chinese 14pt built-in font to the UI-required glyph set.

## Reliability

- Bound compressed file-manager responses and batch file-list JSON streaming for large directories.
- Incorporate upstream reader fixes through `develop` commit `ba1b849f`, including sequential Settings page data loading.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing books, reading progress, and saved theme choices are preserved.
- EPUB book and section cache versions remain unchanged at 11 and 50/51, so no pagination cache rebuild is required.
- Electronic Woodfish creates `/.crosspoint/woodfish.bin` only after use.

> **WeRead security notice:** WeRead uses an unofficial Web protocol that may change without notice. Device traffic is encrypted with wolfSSL, but the current client does not verify the server CA or host identity. Use WeRead only on a trusted network.

## Firmware assets

- `firmware.bin` — international firmware
- `firmware-cn.bin` — Simplified Chinese firmware
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin` — complete web/USB flashing support

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0x1abin/crossmux/compare/1.5.4...1.5.5
